using namespace std;
using i64 = long long;
const i64 MOD = 1000000007;

i64 mod_add(i64 a, i64 b) {
    return (a + b) % MOD;
}

i64 mod_sub(i64 a, i64 b) {
    a -= b;
    return (a < 0) ? a + MOD : a;
}

i64 mod_mul(i64 a, i64 b) {
    return (a * b) % MOD;
}

i64 mod_pow(i64 base, i64 exp) {
    i64 result = 1;
    base %= MOD;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = mod_mul(result, base);
        base = mod_mul(base, base);
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

i64 mod_inv(i64 x) {
    return mod_pow(x, MOD - 2);
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    
    vector<vector<i64>> A(n, vector<i64>(n));
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            cin >> A[i][j];
            A[i][j] = mod_mul(A[i][j], mod_inv(100));
        }
    }
    
    vector<int> popcount(1 << n, 0);
    for (int mask = 1; mask < (1 << n); ++mask) {
        popcount[mask] = popcount[mask >> 1] + (mask & 1);
    }
    
    vector<vector<int>> masks_by_count(n + 1);
    for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); ++mask) {
        masks_by_count[popcount[mask]].push_back(mask);
    }
    
    vector<vector<vector<i64>>> T(n + 1, vector<vector<i64>>(n + 1, vector<i64>(1 << n, 0)));
    for (int k = 0; k <= n; ++k) {
        for (int idx = 0; idx < (int)masks_by_count[k].size(); ++idx) {
            int cm = masks_by_count[k][idx];
            for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); ++mask) {
                i64 result = 0;
                if ((mask & cm) == mask) continue;
                for (int x = 0; x < n; ++x) {
                    if (cm & (1 << x)) continue;
                    if ((mask & (1 << x)) == 0) continue;
                    int newmask = cm | (1 << x);
                    result |= (1LL << (int)masks_by_count[popcount[newmask]].size());
                }
                T[k][idx][mask] = result;
            }
        }
    }
    
    vector<unordered_map<i64, i64>> DP(n + 1);
    DP[0][1] = 1;
    
    for (int k = 0; k < n; ++k) {
        for (int edges = 0; edges < (1 << n); ++edges) {
            i64 prob = 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                if (edges & (1 << i)) {
                    prob = mod_mul(prob, A[k][i]);
                } else {
                    prob = mod_mul(prob, mod_sub(1, A[k][i]));
                }
            }
            for (const auto& entry : DP[k]) {
                i64 mask = entry.first;
                i64 newmask = 0;
                i64 p = mod_mul(prob, entry.second);
                for (int i = 0; i < (int)masks_by_count[k].size(); ++i) {
                    if (mask & (1 << i)) {
                        newmask |= T[k][i][edges];
                    }
                }
                if (newmask != 0) {
                    DP[k + 1][newmask] = mod_add(DP[k + 1][newmask], p);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    cout << DP[n][1] << '\n';
